mechanism: Finasteride inhibits 5-alpha reductase, reducing conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT), which may reduce finasteride's efficacy in treating androgenetic alopecia or benign prostatic hyperplasia while exogenous testosterone increases substrate availability.
action: Monitor clinical response in patients receiving both agents; consider alternative alopecia/BPH treatment if testosterone therapy is necessary, or evaluate testosterone necessity if finasteride efficacy diminishes.
